subject: Excising stuck chains from a stanfit object (RStan)

messages.author: ee490f1373633c05
messages.subject: Excising stuck chains from a stanfit object (RStan)
parts:
I have a very long Stan run with lots (16 chains).  One of the chains became stuck.  I would like to excise this chain from the stanfit object, and hopefully maintain the resulting object as a valid stanfit object.  Failing that, I just want the output of summary().  How can I do this?  I am using Stan 2.8 via RStan.

I realise the caveats around doing this (MCMC must work all the time, not just for certain initialisations / sampler parameter values), but I'm willing to bear that risk at present.

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Excising stuck chains from a stanfit object (RStan)
parts:
On Wednesday, October 7, 2015 at 5:13:46 AM UTC-4, Julian King wrote:
I have a very long Stan run with lots (16 chains).  One of the chains became stuck.  I would like to excise this chain from the stanfit object, and hopefully maintain the resulting object as a valid stanfit object.  Failing that, I just want the output of summary().  How can I do this?  I am using Stan 2.8 via RStan.

I realise the caveats around doing this (MCMC must work all the time, not just for certain initialisations / sampler parameter values), but I'm willing to bear that risk at present.

The easiest way is to call stan() 16 times (perhaps in parallel) with the same seed and different chain_id to produce a list of 16 stanfit objects. Then drop the chain that got stuck from the list, and call sflist2stanfit() on the list of 15 to produce a single stanfit object.

Ben

P.S. This is a bad idea.
